mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, original_filename, name, phone, email, gender, age, skills, education, work_experience, status, created_at FROM resumes r WHERE r.status = 2 AND ( r.skills LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.education LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
